label: rem:m-tau-knot-prediction
title: The $m_\tau$ knot prediction and its falsification
html:
The CAL-2 critique (rem:epistemic-status-of-calibrations) identifies a structural pattern in the muon-mass identity. Does m_\tau/m_e admit an analogous reading m_\tau/m_e = \mathrm{Vol}(K_\tau)/\hbar_q^{k_\tau}?

Refuted over the searched census (scope-limited). A direct search evaluated 25 hyperbolic knots; no candidate matches within 1\% of the CODATA value 3477.23. The census-reach computation quantifies what the identity demands at the canonical q_0: for k_\tau = 3 the target volume \approx 3.382 lies inside the searched low-crossing range (between \mathrm{Vol}(6_1) \approx 3.164 and \mathrm{Vol}(6_2) \approx 4.401), so that exponent is genuinely refuted at the stated tolerance; for the CAL-2-analogous exponent k_\tau = 2 the target is \approx 34.14 — beyond any knot a 25-entry low-crossing census can contain (volumes near 34 require roughly fifteen or more crossings, links, or composites) — so the k_\tau = 2 identity is untested by the search, not refuted; for k_\tau = 1 the target \approx 344.5 is structurally out of range of any tabulated prime knot. We retain this as a falsifiable observation without proposing a new calibration; the quantified targets are pinned in the witness m-tau-volume-target.witness.json.
